author: DraugrPrime
quote:
I waited 13 **** years for GTA VI not some overpriced, overregulated life simulator! 
GTA was always about doing whatever the hell you wanted. Now the game puts restrictions on practically everything. You can’t steal any car you want whenever you want you can’t explore the entire map from the start you can’t buy your own house you can’t freely build your own criminal empire you can’t pick up prostitutes and even your weapon loadout is restricted. You even have to register a stolen car just to keep it! What the ****?! This is Grand Theft Auto not a digital version of everyday life.
And then theres Jason..after legends like CJ and Tommy we get an ex military guy who often feels more like Lucia’s little **** than a badass, memorable GTA protagonist. At times the whole thing feels more like a loyal bf simulator, complete with grocery shopping and relationship **** than an actual GTA game.
THE PROBLEM ISN’T THAT THE GAME IS REALISTIC. THE PROBLEM IS THAT ROCKSTAR SACRIFICED THE FREEDOM THAT MADE US FALL IN LOVE WITH GTA IN THE FIRST PLACE, ALL IN THE NAME OF REALISM!
The graphics are stunning the world is beautiful and the technology is incredible. But who gives a **** about any of that when the game keeps telling you what you can and can’t do?
GTA used to be an escape from the restrictions of real life. Now we’re getting those same restrictions shoved right back in our faces just with prettier graphics.

After 13 years of waiting, I don’t call that progress. I call it a **** massive disappointment
